title: CppCon 2014: Chandler Carruth "Efficiency with Algorithms, Performance with Data Structures"
summary: Chandler Carruth's CppCon 2014 talk on writing fast C++, explaining why data structure choice and memory layout matter more than clever algorithms. It covers why standard containers like unordered_map perform poorly on modern CPUs.
why: A perennial recommendation for anyone learning performance optimization, cited whenever hash tables, cache behavior or STL containers come up.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I'm also a big fan of "Efficiency with Algorithms, Performance with Data Structures" by Chandler Carruth at CppCon 2014.
